description: Closed-form solutions and Monte Carlo simulations of interface games found that veridical perceptual strategies can be driven to extinction by nonveridical strategies tuned to utility.
limitations: Simple games with frequency-dependent selection and complete mixing in infinite populations, as the authors state.
conflicts_of_interest: The authors are the originators of the interface theory.

sources.quote: We find that veridical perceptions can be driven to extinction by non-veridical strategies that are tuned to utility rather than objective reality.
